svg.title: 证据驱动的推理与评测工程 · 审单执行可靠性与回放评测
svg.desc: Harness 管理调查上下文和执行步骤，模型接口管理调用容量，工具运行环境隔离依赖；任务微调与量化支撑附件分类和证据提取，共享事实、证据校验与标注样本共同支撑审核回放。；案件与执行约束：Task Adapter，Java / Spring，Task ID / Idempotency，Attachment Metadata；Skill Registry，Skill / Policy Version，Tool Contracts / Output Schema；Agent 与受控调用：DeepSeek Harness，Context Management，Step Budget / Retry Policy；Model API Adapter，deepseek-v4-pro，Timeout / Concurrency Limit，Token Budget / Usage；Tool Execution Runtime，Docker / Resource Limits，Evidence ID / Tool Result，Contract Tests；证据一致性与结果检查：Case State Store，PostgreSQL，Shared Facts / Pending Checks，Document Citation Index；Evidence Validator，JSON Schema，Citation / Calculation Check，Missing Evidence Detection；样本回放与版本评测：Case Replay Dataset，Reviewed Cases / Expected Facts，Skill / Prompt / Tool Version；Evaluation Pipeline，Langfuse / Dataset Replay，Judgment / Citation Accuracy，Tool Errors / Cost / Latency；01 Task Adapter → DeepSeek Harness：审核任务与材料引用；02 Skill Registry → DeepSeek Harness：版本化 Skill 与工具契约；03 DeepSeek Harness ↔ Model API Adapter：模型请求 / 推理结果；04 DeepSeek Harness ↔ Tool Execution Runtime：受控工具调用 / 证据返回；05 DeepSeek Harness ↔ Case State Store：共享事实读取 / 步骤状态更新；06 DeepSeek Harness → Evidence Validator：责任建议与证据引用；07 Evidence Validator → Case Replay Dataset：校验结果 / 复核样本；08 Case Replay Dataset → Evaluation Pipeline：按版本回放并比较结果；09 DeepSeek Harness → Evaluation Pipeline：执行步骤 / 工具异常 / 模型用量
